sloka: अथ संस्मारयामास राघवं मातलिस्तदा ।अजानन्निव किं वीर त्वमेनमनुवर्तसे ।। ६.१११.१ ।।
transliteration: atha saṁsmārayāmāsa rāghavaṁ mātalistadā ।ajānanniva kiṁ vīra tvamenamanuvartase ।। 6.111.1 ।।

translations.english: Matali reminded Rama in this way," O heroic Rama, why are you doing this way, as if you do not know?"
